{{Youmay|Nlorna flower perfume|[[nlora perfume]]}}
'''Nlorna flower perfume''' was a sweet fragrance worn by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Erisi Dlarit]] while she was impersonating a [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] noble during her [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="XW">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Michael A. Stackpole]] created nlorna flower perfume for ''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]'', published in [[1996]]. [[James Luceno]] later wrote ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]'', which featured "nlora perfume"; this may be a misspelling of nlorna.
